title: Campus Dining and Food Venues
aliases: where can I eat on campus
content: Campus dining at VIT-AP includes several venues beyond the hostel mess: Rockplaza, Swagat, Maggie Hotspot, Food Street (with outlets like Zuzu, Oasis, and CS), Bits and Bytes, and a general Canteen. Hostel mess service itself is bundled into the hostel fee (room + mess + laundry) and covers regular meals for resident students; see the hostel fee structure for cost details.

title: Mess Meal Timings
content: Specific mess meal timings (breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner) are not published on the public VIT-AP website. Current timings are posted on hostel notice boards and communicated by the hostel mess office directly to residents, since they can vary by hostel block or semester.
